artworks.title: SARIBELLA
artworks.description: Saribella is a breathtaking, sultry fusion of traditional allure and ultra-modern high fashion. Drenched in a deep, commanding shade of crimson red, this evening gown is designed for a confident woman

artworks.title: PINTA
artworks.description: "Pinta" is a striking, high-fashion evening gown illustration that balances dramatic volume with a sleek, structured silhouette. The design exudes modern glamour, relying heavily on texture, contrast, and shimmering details to create a captivating visual impact.
